subject: ddl: refine the criterion for modify column (#64834)
summary: Reviewed modify-column job-type selection changes in `pkg/ddl/modify_column.go`, focusing on reorg gating for integer unsigned flips and collation compatibility, plus the TiFlash/partition fallback. The new use of `collate.CompatibleCollate` matches the collator mapping (same collator implementations) and `codec.EncodeKey`’s collation-based key conversion, so skipping index/optimization reorg for “compatible” collations looks correct; the added forced-reorg cases are conservative for stats/metadata safety. No Blocker/High issues found; no later upstream/master edits to the touched files detected.
